note: Rest has only two kinds (user decision): at home (Sil keeps him company, free) and outing (pick a place, spend money, meet people and things). The sanatorium is forced only when very sick and the player cannot pick it. Each takes one period, settled day by day. Resting on a Sunday counts as ordinary rest
